macd.partial_week_policy: drop incomplete final bins; allow common Friday market closures after a Thursday final session
macd.event_and_strategy_execution: next trading session close after completed weekly signal
macd.event_inference: descriptive only; overlapping forward windows are serially dependent and no naive IID confidence intervals are reported

seasonality_multiple_testing.qvalue_asset: Benjamini-Hochberg across 12 months within each sample/asset
seasonality_multiple_testing.qvalue_family: Benjamini-Hochberg across all asset-month tests within each sample

election_permutation.qvalues: Benjamini-Hochberg within sample and across the full reported family
election_permutation.exchangeability_caveat: four-year calendar labels are deterministic; permutation results are exploratory

breadth.eligibility_50d: valid latest observation and 50 valid daily observations
breadth.eligibility_200d: valid latest observation and 200 valid daily observations

regime_boundaries: ex-post descriptive; not a real-time signal

sector_inception_caveats.GICS_2018: major names migrated among XLK/XLY/XLC; pre/post sector leadership is not compositionally identical
